key_review_findings: DCP 26-03-124 supersedes DCP 23-04-118; covers qualified pharmacists/interns and named injections including newer HIV/sexual-health agents; adult >=18, no IV, single dose, valid Rx.
DCP 26-08-125 supersedes DCP 25-04-124: single-location pharmacist MCSR exception, NPI required, MassHealth enrollment encouraged (not same as mandatory), service optional.
EC statewide standing order under M.G.L. c94C §19A requires no additional course; separate independent hormonal contraceptive prescribing under DCP26-08-125 does require training.
FDA Opill is daily OTC contraception not EC; FDA Ella remains Rx-only while MA statewide EC standing order provides pharmacist dispensing route.
MA-EXP-0351,0367,0383 all-correct SATA are currently in default selection; flag as MAJOR_REWRITE rather than silently rewriting historic answer keys.
PUB02 four-item CDTM participation attestation comparison is conditional: definitive cross-path documentary reconciliation pending.
source_limitations: Mass.gov text extraction provided source clauses, but web PDF screenshots could not be retrieved; claim not independently audited.
Question families share a two-case stem across four questions and repeated proposition pools, so realism and psychometric discrimination remain weak.
CDTM participation attestation comparator requires current Board application evidence and is not fully settled.
This review does NOT add 40 distinct cases, change the public bank answers, or complete independent canonical/notes atomic-claim audit.
